about: Experiment 27 (docs/experiments.md). VGGT single mode, room A, the walk frame's camera token after global block g; 128 target-donor pairs (vggt_patch.py's draw). Transfer is the fraction of the target-donor line the prediction moves (mean); meters and degrees are medians over pairs; heading gap closed is a mean over pairs whose clean predicted headings differ by >= 30 deg. Intervals: 95% percentile bootstrap over pairs (10,000 resamples, seed 0), paired across conditions.

labels.difference_pca10: difference PCA 10 (cross-fitted over 8 folds of pairs)
labels.position_pca10_all_even: position PCA 10 fit on all 6,144 even-walk frames
labels.position_pca10_heading_balanced: position PCA 10 fit on heading-balanced even-walk frames

heading_balanced.reading: position transfer does not depend on heading in the bin means; heading moves with position even after balancing (a pose subspace)

summary.units: transfer and heading_gap_closed are fractions (0 = no effect, 1 = the donor's value; means over pairs); *_m are meters and *_deg degrees (medians over pairs); share_median is the median fraction of the target-donor residual difference (squared norm) inside the subspace; fit_variance_frac the fraction of the 2,048 fit frames' residual variance inside it; ci95 = paired percentile bootstrap over pairs
